headline: German Development Bank KfW to Fund Bogota Metro Line 4 Technical Study
summary: German development bank KfW will provide 800,000 euros to evaluate the technical and financial viability of Bogota's Metro Line 4 project.
why: International development bank funding underpins large-scale urban infrastructure projects in emerging markets, facilitating long-term capital deployment.
